svg.aria-label: Taskflow, a task manager that reached me as plain code. I added containers, a CI/CD pipeline, a home on AWS and a chat assistant. Animation: someone asks the assistant how the pods and the database are doing, it calls its tools, the three pods light up, a database chart is drawn and it answers.
